issues.explanation: Ep3 says Vanessa was engaged to Adrian for two years, but Ep5 has her claim she gave him four years of her life. The durations conflict unless the four years covers dating plus the engagement.
issues.suggested_fix: Change Vanessa's line to 'two years of my life', or add a line that they dated two years before getting engaged.
